short: The commission JSON API, one file per act
is: The user-scoped commission API, one file per act, all behind a uniform closed-door 404 for non-participants — each act a thin driver over the matching `application::commission::*` use case.
conventions: Commissions are user-scoped — no Account required (DD 26247170) — and entirely Index-side (never touch atproto).
Existence is participant-only knowledge: non-participants and absent ids get the same 404, never a 403.
A new act adds a file here rather than growing a hotspot.

The handler shape (ZMVP-205): `CallingUser` in, then the `{id}` through `CommissionPath` (a malformed id answers the same 404 as an id that names nothing; a second path parameter keeps its own `Path` extraction, the id read there as `IgnoredAny`), then `state.app().commissions().<act>(command, now)`, with the error mapped through the shared `CommissionError → Problem` impl in `mod.rs` — no handler builds a ports struct or opens a transaction.
`channel.rs` and `elements.rs` are the two exceptions: no use case covers them, so they keep `require_owner` (the last driver-side authz) plus an inline unit of work until one exists.

The interim guard (until ARC-4 moves them into use cases): `channel.rs`'s and `elements.rs`'s six calls on a unit's `commissions()` and `changelog()` each carry `#[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods, reason = "ARC-4 moves this into a use case")]` on its own statement, under api/clippy.toml's ban; a new call fails clippy.
entry_points: mod.rs (router assembly + the CommissionError → Problem mapping)

fs.name: archive.rs
fs.role: POST archive / unarchive → commission::archive / unarchive

fs.name: changelog.rs
fs.role: GET /{id}/changelog → commission::changelog::read

fs.name: channel.rs
fs.role: PUT/DELETE /{id}/channel linked-channel pointer — NOT migrated: no use case exists, so require_owner + an inline UnitOfWork stay (TODO(engineer)); link_channel keeps its #[deprecated]

fs.name: create.rs
fs.role: POST /commissions → commission::create, the Den's write, which answers the created commission as the write left it; rendered into CreateCommissionResponse; the title is parsed with FromStr before any use case runs, so a blank title or one the name rule refuses → 422 with a field error at #/title

fs.name: deadline.rs
fs.role: PUT/DELETE deadline + manual Delayed flag → commission::deadline::* and deadline::status::* (a `late` token refused 422 here, before any use case); the deadline's DELETE keeps a raised Delayed flag stored, shown nowhere until a deadline is set again

fs.name: delete.rs
fs.role: DELETE — fact-free hard delete → commission::delete

fs.name: elements.rs
fs.role: POST/DELETE elements, the flat composition write surface — NOT migrated: no use case exists, so require_owner + an inline UnitOfWork stay (TODO(engineer))

fs.name: files.rs
fs.role: multipart upload / download → commission::files::upload / download; HTTP streaming glue stays here

fs.name: get.rs
fs.role: GET /{id} → commission::get, the read: the fields every opener may see (never the owner, never the linked channel), the deadline status derived at the request's time and the viewer's acts and lifecycle targets, rendered into GetCommissionResponse by an impl From<get::Output>; a stranger the Den doesn't open it to gets a made-up id's 404

fs.name: invitations.rs
fs.role: POST/DELETE seat invitations → commission::invitations::issue / revoke

fs.name: lifecycle.rs
fs.role: PUT /{id}/lifecycle → commission::lifecycle::move_to, answering 204; the step is parsed before any use case runs, so a token outside the vocabulary (case included) or a missing one → 422 with a field error at #/to, code unknown_value, its detail fixed

fs.name: markup.rs
fs.role: POST /{id}/files/{file_id}/markup → commission::markup

fs.name: maturity.rs
fs.role: PUT /{id}/maturity (replace-only) → commission::maturity::set

fs.name: mod.rs
fs.role: router assembly, body limits, the CommissionError→Problem mapping (create, rename, the read and the lifecycle move map through it too), title_refused (a title the name rule refuses at parse, as a field error at #/title), and require_owner — the last driver-side gate, kept only for the unmigrated channel/elements acts

fs.name: notes.rs
fs.role: POST /{id}/notes → commission::notes::attach

fs.name: positioning.rs
fs.role: account-side placement + view grants → commission::place, view::grant / view::revoke; grants are per-User (DD 29130754 amended 2026-09-04), so the route's {account_id} segment is dead (TODO(engineer))

fs.name: rename.rs
fs.role: PATCH /{id}/title → commission::rename, owner-only; the path's id wins over the body's; answers the commission as the write left it, read by the gate's lent view in the write's unit, rendered into RenameCommissionResponse; the title is parsed before anyone's standing is checked, so a refused title → 422 with a field error at #/title for anyone, a Participant who isn't the owner included

fs.name: seats.rs
fs.role: POST /{id}/seats — declare a vacant typed Seat → commission::seats::declare

fs.name: slots.rs
fs.role: POST /{id}/slots — all-or-nothing Slot batch → commission::slots::declare

fs.name: status.rs
fs.role: PUT/DELETE /{id}/status/direction → commission::status::direction::set / clear

fs.name: tests.rs
fs.role: unit tests for mod.rs's CommissionError→Problem mapping

notes: `unknown_surface` is `422` not `404`: the `(tab, surface)` skeleton is code-declared and global, so an undeclared pair is a program fact, not a per-commission one — contrast `tab_not_found`/`element_not_found` (404, per-row, cross-commission collapse).
`SeatNotFound` maps to `element_not_found` (a Seat is an Element).
